item.summary: fix(file-transfer): remove wall-clock race from symlink promptness test (#130279) The test raced the real UNSAFE_ARCHIVE rejection against its own 2s setTimeout to prove "settles promptly," which can flip to "timeout" instead of "rejected" whenever the CI runner stalls (observed in run 32978693452). Vitest's own per-test timeout already bounds a hang regression, so drop the manual race and assert the rejection directly.
